title: WINDOW ELECTRIC CONTROL-CONTENTS
summary: RPO A31 power windows: contents of the option plus the door end of the installation. The window regulator & motor assembly mounts inside each door with a pad cemented to it; the door harness runs from the body through a conduit (wiring shield between hinge pillar and door), is held by a clip, and plugs into the motor connectors. The power-window circuit breaker mounts behind the dash with a screw and nut, and its feed plugs into the fuse panel receptacle marked "Acc. Fused". Related sheet: A2 (console switches & wiring harness).
